name: Shenzhen Baoming Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Baoming Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of flat panel display devices in China. The company is involved in the research and development, production, and sale of new energy lithium battery materials and composite copper foils for applications in power batteries, energy storage batteries, and consumer batteries. It also provides LED backlights; and deep processing LCD panels. In addition, the company offers small and medium-sized LED backlights and MiniLED backlights for use in automobiles, tablets, laptops and smartphones. It also exports its products.
